hooks.name: Test changed components and run visual audit after push
hooks.description: After a git push, identify which files were modified and run the appropriate tests. If frontend page components or CSS/theme files changed, also run a visual audit and invoke @redteam for review.

action.prompt:
A git push just happened. Check which files changed in the last commit with `git diff --name-only HEAD~1`. Then run the appropriate tests:

FRONTEND: If any frontend page components (frontend/src/app/*/page.tsx) or test files (frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts) were modified, run the corresponding Playwright tests. Map: /brain→brain.spec.ts, /create→create.spec.ts, /talent→talent.spec.ts, /assets→assets.spec.ts, /models→models.spec.ts, /admin→admin.spec.ts, /training→training.spec.ts, /settings→settings.spec.ts, /production→production.spec.ts, /publish→publish.spec.ts, /analytics→analytics.spec.ts, /editor→editor.spec.ts, /workflows→workflows.spec.ts, /admin/fleet→fleet.spec.ts. Run: `cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/{matched}.spec.ts --project=desktop --workers=1`.

VISUAL AUDIT: If ANY frontend page components (frontend/src/app/*/page.tsx), CSS files (frontend/src/app/globals.css, tailwind.config.ts), layout files (frontend/src/app/layout.tsx), or shared UI components (frontend/src/components/*) were modified, ALSO run the visual audit: `cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/visual-audit.spec.ts --project=desktop`. Screenshots will be saved to frontend/visual-audit/. After capturing, compare against any existing baselines. If pixel difference >5% on any page OR a new page was added, invoke @redteam with: 'Visual audit detected significant UI changes after push. Review screenshots in frontend/visual-audit/ for: layout alignment, color contrast, empty states, loading states, button hierarchy, mobile responsiveness, visual consistency between pages.'

BACKEND: If any backend Python files (backend/**/*.py) were modified, verify the backend still works by running: `curl -s http://localhost:8000/ && curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health`. If specific modules changed, also verify their imports work: `cd /Users/garymcdaniel/kiro/ai-studio88 && /Users/garymcdaniel/.local/bin/uv run python -c "from backend.main import app; print(f'Routes: {len(app.routes)}')"`. If infrastructure files changed (backend/infrastructure/*), also check: `curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/v1/infrastructure/worker/progress`.

AUTH REGRESSION CHECK: If auth-related files changed (backend/auth.py, frontend/src/middleware.ts, any file containing 'require_auth'), invoke @redteam with: 'Auth-related code was modified. Verify P0-1 (auth enforcement) and P0-2 (tenant isolation) still hold. Check that all mutation endpoints have require_auth.'

REGRESSION WATCHPOINTS: After running tests, check for known P0/P1 regression symptoms:
- Any 200 response to unauthenticated mutation requests (P0-1 regression)
- Any cross-org data leakage in responses (P0-2 regression)
- Any hardcoded external URLs (P0-3 regression)
- Any new endpoints without auth guards
If regressions detected, immediately report RED status and invoke @redteam.

If NO testable files changed (only docs, scripts, configs), skip testing.

Update .kiro/steering/uat-system.md only if tests were run.
